title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew made with tender lamb and aromatic spices. This recipe serves 4-6 people and can be cooked in a slow cooker or Dutch oven.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, and browned lamb to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the tagine in the preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the sliced almonds, if using.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 15 minutes before serving.
